text: Looking into all three issues now.
Confirmed: both balancers index into an empty target slice. Fixing Next() to return nil when there are no targets (and guarding the proxy middleware against a nil target).
Confirmed: Router.Find sets the context path to the raw request path before matching, so unmatched requests keep it. Fixing so Path() stays "" when no route matched.
Confirmed: Scheme() returns any non-empty header value verbatim. Fixing it to only accept http/https and fall through to the next header, defaulting to http.

Fixed. `randomBalancer.Next` and `roundRobinBalancer.Next` now return `nil` when the target list is empty (no more `Intn`/divide-by-zero panics), and the proxy middleware returns 503 instead of dereferencing a nil target. Verified with your exact snippets: both return nil, and `Proxy(NewRandomBalancer(nil))` / `Proxy(NewRoundRobinBalancer(nil))` respond 503 without panicking.

Fixed. `Router.Find` no longer pre-seeds the context with the request path, so `c.Path()` is `""` when no route matched (your `/does-not-exist` case) and still the registered pattern (e.g. `/users/:id`) for matches. 404 handling unchanged.

Fixed. `Scheme()` now only accepts `http`/`https` from X-Forwarded-Proto, X-Forwarded-Protocol and X-Url-Scheme, skipping invalid values and falling through to the next header, defaulting to `http`. Your case (Proto: ftp, Url-Scheme: https) now returns `https`; Proto: ftp alone returns `http`.

Confirmed: the map branch of bindData stores only the first value (`v[0]`) and always as a string, so map[string][]string panics and map[string]interface{} gets a bare string. Fixing it to bind the whole value slice for slice/interface destinations.

Confirmed: Group.Use registers catch-all NotFoundHandler routes for every method, so the second group's Use overwrites the first group's GET /group route. Fixing so those catch-all routes never overwrite an already-registered route.

Confirmed: gzip.Writer flushes its 10-byte header even for an empty write, but res.Size stays 0, so the cleanup deletes Content-Encoding and discards the rest, leaving a headerless gzip fragment. Fixing so a real (even empty) write keeps Content-Encoding: gzip and emits a complete stream.

Fixed. `Group.Use` no longer registers its catch-all NotFoundHandler routes over paths/methods that already have a route, so two groups sharing a prefix no longer clobber each other. Verified: `GET /group` runs h with m1 and `GET /group/other` runs h with m2; group middleware still runs for unmatched paths. Full suite green.

Fixed. The gzip middleware now distinguishes "nothing written at all" from "an empty body was written", so `c.String(200, "")` yields `Content-Encoding: gzip`, `Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8` and a complete gzip stream that decompresses to "". Verified by test; the 204/no-write and error-return cases still behave as before.

Fixed. The map branch of bindData now binds the whole value slice when the destination element type can hold it: `map[string][]string` gives {"tag": ["a","b"]} (no more reflect panic), `map[string]interface{}` gives {"tag": []string{"a","b"}}, and `map[string]string` still binds the first value without panicking. Verified with `?tag=a&tag=b`.
